findings.text: follow-on: class_counts.notation_should_be_excluded (srtj-docs-bracket-census-run.py:335) is built as `[entry for entry in prose if not entry["gate_predicate_says_prose"]]`, but `prose` is the set whose reason starts with PROSE_REASON and so comes from find_prose_bracket_phrases, which at doc_links.py:121/:102 emits only phrases that already pass _is_prose_bracket; every member therefore has gate_predicate_says_prose True and the class is 0 by construction and cannot redden on any regression, so the HTML's §2 table row presenting the 0 as `_is_prose_bracket` re-run over each flagged phrase is a restatement of the selecting predicate rather than evidence the exclusions work.

follow-on: dd_token_scan_positive_control (srtj-docs-bracket-census-run.py:417-434) evaluates only the Python predicate contains_dd_token on the constant _DD_PLANTED, while the node's load-bearing zero accepted_documents_containing_any_dd_token (0 of 2,530) is produced by the Cypher `MATCH (sn:StandardName) WHERE sn.documentation CONTAINS 'dd:'` at :203-208, which the control never executes; the `method: "plant in a disposable copy"` label is inaccurate because no document is planted in the graph, so the CONTAINS path that actually returns the zero remains unproven.

follow-on: dd_link_syntax_is_a_valid_gate_target (srtj-docs-bracket-census-run.py:437-441) records its result under a `valid` key and carries no `passed` key, so census.log prints `passed= None` for it while the other eight controls print a boolean; a reader that reads the nine controls by their passed key cannot tell this one passed, and it persists unchanged from the prior review's fourth finding.

item_verdicts.diff: read the single gained commit 6e34f1e5 against base 0d18022e0: srtj-docs-bracket-census-run.py drops its copy of the notation-class helper and the unit/interval regexes and imports the owner's predicate, adds the independent instrument and its census (run.py:83-110, :221-300), and the HTML (+161/-94) corrects the §1 citations and adds the independent-exclusion table; every changed path is inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the brief's done-when asks for the JSON written by the runner with a log ending EXIT=0 plus the fragment answering all three questions with cited lines, per-class counts and examples; census.log:14 ends in EXIT=0, srtj-docs-bracket-census.json records documents_read 2530 and class_counts {bare_prose_bracket 613, self_link 24, other 10}, and the HTML carries five verbatim examples per class.
item_verdicts.goal: the increment exists to make the census's exclusion count independent evidence rather than a restatement of the rule; srtj-docs-bracket-census-run.py:52-54 now imports _is_prose_bracket and find_prose_bracket_phrases from the owner and :83-110 adds the independent instrument, and the HTML keeps answering the node's three questions with the counts unchanged at 613 prose, 24 self-link and 10 other over 2,530 documents.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states status complete, records the gate command, the census log path, the imported gate module path and the headline counts, and carries the same three follow-ons the runner's own output names.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the source manifest declares three write paths under docs/evidence/fragments/sn-review-through-jev/; the diff 0d18022e0..6e34f1e55 touches exactly those three files (census-run.py, census.html, census.json) and no other.

justifications.durability: the only guards are the runner's inline controls, which redden if the gate stops failing a prose bracket or a self-link (run.py:390-416), but no assertion covers the census counts and the notation class (run.py:335) and the dd: zero (run.py:203-208) cannot redden on any regression.
justifications.evidence: census.log records EXIT=0 and the counts, the dd: scan now carries a positive control (run.py:417) and the exclusions a second instrument (run.py:280-300), but the notation_should_be_excluded class (run.py:335) is 0 by construction and the dd: control exercises the Python predicate rather than the Cypher CONTAINS that produced the zero.
justifications.fit: the three files keep the sibling *-run.py / .json / .html evidence-fragment idiom, the added functions follow the module's own docstring-and-type-hint style, and every graph_ops.py and doc_links.py citation in the HTML was re-verified against the worktree source (e.g. _extract_links_from_docs graph_ops.py:522, _BARE_BRACKET_RE doc_links.py:20 with its lookbehind and lookahead).
justifications.goal_fidelity: srtj-docs-bracket-census-run.py:83-110 adds the independent instrument the increment exists to add and :52-54 imports the owner predicate, and the HTML §1-§3 keep answering the node's three questions with counts unchanged (613 / 24 / 10 over 2,530).
justifications.reuse: srtj-docs-bracket-census-run.py:52-54 now imports _is_prose_bracket and find_prose_bracket_phrases from the owner instead of carrying the base's copy, resolving the prior duplication; the only re-implemented patterns left are the deliberately independent instrument at run.py:83-110, whose independence is the evidence method rather than a capability fork.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff 0d18022e0..6e34f1e55 changes only srtj-docs-bracket-census-run.py, srtj-docs-bracket-census.html and srtj-docs-bracket-census.json, the three paths the manifest declares and the brief's write scope names.
